detail.longDescription: I'm trying to convert a table to LaTeX using df.to_latex() . I've become aware of styler , but I am not super expert in LaTeX itself and write largely in Markdown and convert to Pandoc with an engine. I am hoping to bold my column names and row names. The following, after much trial and error, works: styler = df.style.format( precision=0, thousands=",", escape="latex") styler.map_index(lambda v: "font-weight: bold;", axis="index") styler.map_index(lambda v: "font-weight: bold;", axis="columns") s = styler.to_latex(convert_css=True, hrules=True) figs = "~/Desktop/code/working-drafts/diss2figs" with open(f'{figs}/sample_sizes.tex', 'w') as tbl: tbl.write(s) However, when I add environment="longtable" to the to.latex() argument, it fails to compile, but my table is very long, and I would like to have that option. Interestingly, the following also works to make the table long, but I have, of course, had to give up on the bolding. styler = df.style.format( precision=0, thousands=",", escape="latex") r = styler.to_latex(convert_css=True, hrules=True, environment="longtable") figs = "/Users/griffinjmbur/Desktop/code/working-drafts/diss2figs" with open(f'{figs}/sample_sizes.tex', 'w') as tbl: tbl.write(r) I am not at all a LaTeX expert; I learned the syntax of writing it back when I was a Jupyter Notebooks n00b, and I'm good at that, but I will confess to not really understanding how to compile it. I do notice that the problem appears to be this. If I leave out the "longtable" option, I get this raw LaTeX back: \begin{tabular}{lrrrr} \toprule & \multicolumn{2}{r}{\bfseries raw count} & \multicolumn{2}{r}{\bfseries sum of weights} \\ retiree & \bfseries False & \bfseries True & \bfseries False & \bfseries True \\ year & & & & \\ \midrule \bfseries 1980 & 55,039 & 14,887 & 126,900,099 & 28,367,901 \\ ... \bfseries 2018 & 53,592 & 15,172 & 186,545,780 & 57,685,123 \\ \bottomrule \end{tabular} but with "longtable" in the environment, I get this \begin{longtable}{lrrrr} \toprule & \multicolumn{2}{r}{\font-weightbold raw count} & \multicolumn{2}{r}{\font-weightbold sum of weights} \\ retiree & \font-weightbold False & \font-weightbold True & \font-weightbold False & \font-weightbold True \\ year & & & & \\ \midrule \endfirsthead \toprule & \multicolumn{2}{r}{\font-weightbold raw count} & \multicolumn{2}{r}{\font-weightbold sum of weights} \\ retiree & \font-weightbold False & \font-weightbold True & \font-weightbold False & \font-weightbold True \\ year & & & & \\ \midrule \endhead \midrule \multicolumn{5}{r}{Continued on next page} \\ \midrule \endfoot \bottomrule \endlastfoot \font-weightbold 1980 & 55,039 & 14,887 & 126,900,099 & 28,367,901 \\ ... \font-weightbold 2018 & 53,592 & 15,172 & 186,545,780 & 57,685,123 \\ \end{longtable} How can I have bold headings in my longtable ?
